notes: Cibiel 2014 PLOS ONE ("From ugly duckling to swan: anti-Annexin A2 aptamer ACE4"). Selection performed against cells over-expressing ETBR; the ACE4 aptamer was later identified as anti-Annexin A2 (hence the ENA project title). M&M library template: "5'-GGGAGAUGAUCCGUUGAUGCGAG-(N50)-AAGUCGUCGUUCGUAGGCAGAAUC-3'". These primer_*_truth fields are the LIBRARY CONSTANTS (flanking the random region) — NOT the PCR primers P60/P70, which are different sequences (P60 forward = GATTCTGCCTACGAACGACGACTT; P70 reverse = CTCGAGTAATACGACTCACTATAGGGAGATGATCCGTTGATGCGAG with T7 promoter). Library U-letters normalized to T here; selexprep handles U-T via allow_ut.

Pleiko 2019 Scientific Reports differential binding cell-SELEX against ccRCC RCC-MF cells with RC-124 negative control. M&M oligonucleotide library: 5'-ATCCAGAGTGACGCAGCA-N40-TGGACACGGTGGCTTAGT-3'. The paper states sequencing data are available under SRA accession PRJEB28411. ROUND-MAP NOTE (Phase 6b.9): round numbers inferred from sample aliases; used only to enable primer-recovery inference, not per-round biological claims.

Ozaki 2020 NAR ("RaptRanker"), Data1 = HT-SELEX vs human transglutaminase 2 (TG2). Template per M&M: 5'-TCACACTAGCACGCATAGG-30N-CATCTGACCTCTCTCCTGCTCCC-3'. T7-transcribed RNA library. READ-LEVEL RE-CURATION (Phase 6b.10 Troncone 2): deposited reads are the cDNA strand (reverse-complement) with a T7 promoter prepended, so primer_*_truth here are the READ-LEVEL flanks (5' = T7 + revcomp(paper 3' constant); 3' = revcomp(paper 5' constant)), derived by independent position-anchored consensus (benchmarks/read_level_flanks.py, NOT from detect) and cross-checked against revcomp(paper) — see read_level_truth_provenance.tsv. n_length_truth unchanged: 5p_len + N + 3p_len = observed read-mode length.

Ozaki 2020 NAR ("RaptRanker"), Data2 = HT-SELEX vs human integrin alpha-V beta-3. Template per M&M: 5'-GAGGATCCATGTATGCGCACATA-40N-CTTCTGGTCGAAGTTCTCCC-3'. T7-transcribed RNA library. Aptamer footprints vs alpha-synuclein fibrillar polymorphs (NAR 2024). Template per M&M: 5'-CCTACACGACGCTCTTCCGATCT(N35)TCAGCCTCAACGGATACTCTCCC-3'. WARNING: the 5' constant is the revcomp of TruSeq R1 (AGATCGGAAGAGC) — this row will likely trigger selexprep's adapter-trap blacklist (KNOWN_ADAPTERS) and surface as PARTIAL_5P / MISMATCH or safe-failure. Useful edge case for testing adapter-vs-primer disambiguation. ADAPTER-CONTROL RECLASSIFICATION (Phase 6b.10): reads are raw full-length (primers present) but the 5' constant = revcomp(TruSeq R1 adapter), so this is an adapter-collision NEGATIVE CONTROL, NOT a recovery case — excluded from the recovery denominator. Correct behavior = no primer call (detect refused: null/null).

Hu 2024 Scientific Reports ASFV p30 MB-SELEX. Main text reports PRJNA990511 SRA data, a 40 nt random ssDNA library flanked by two 20 nt primer sequences, and Table S1/S3 sequence details. Supplementary Table S3 reports initial library 5'-ATTGGCACTCCACGCATAGG-(N)40-CCTATGCGTGCTACCGTGAA-3'; Primer B is the reverse-complement primer TTCACGGTAGCACGCATAGG.

Ali 2022 Sci Rep "A sputum bioassay for airway eosinophilia using an eosinophil peroxidase aptamer" (EPX). Library DNA_L was source-verified from MOESM1 supp PDF page 2 Table S1 (text-extraction-resistant raster table; verified by rendering with PyMuPDF/fitz at matrix=3x and visual inspection). FP1 (forward primer 1) = ATGCCATCCTACCAAC = 5' library constant. READ-LEVEL RE-CURATION (Phase 6b.10): independent R2-manifest consensus over 1,945,073 deposited reads gives 5' R2 prefix TCGAGTTCAGAGCTC (positions 0-14 support 95.65-96.90%; exact-window support 0.9215, Hamming<=1 support 0.9464), whose reverse-complement is GAGCTCTGAACTCGA. primer_3p_truth is therefore the read-level 3' flank physically present in deposited R2 reads; this supersedes the earlier supplement-derived RP1 interpretation CCAGTTCAGAGCTC / GAGCTCTGAACTGG for Figure A, which scores deposited-read primer recovery rather than primer-label transcription. ROUND-MAP NOTE (Phase 6b.9): round numbers inferred from sample aliases; used only to enable primer-recovery inference, not per-round biological claims. Phase 6b.10 detect passes R2 via --paired-r2, so this row is no longer R1-only. score_3p=false (Troncone 2): the 3' truth GAGCTCTGAACTCGA is read-resolved (R2 consensus), so it is NOT scored toward paper-grounded recovery (scoring detect's read-derived 3' against a read-derived truth is circular); only the paper-grounded 5' (FP1) is scored, so the pair is classified on the 5' alone (pair_partial, not pair_exact).

Kolm 2020 Sci Rep ("DNA aptamers against bacterial cells can be efficiently selected by a SELEX process using state-of-the-art qPCR and ultra-deep sequencing"), whole-cell SELEX vs Enterococcus faecalis DSM-20478. M&M ssDNA library: 5'-TAGGGAAGAGAAGGACATATGAT-N40-TTGACTAGTACATGACCACTTGA-3' (paper-grounded; same library independently reproduced by Codex's primary-source search). TRONCONE 2 (first DNA addition). Forward orientation confirmed by a TARGETED read check (non-circular — checks the known paper sequence, not de-novo consensus, not detect): R1 87.95% start with the 5' constant, R2 83.17% start with the reverse primer = revcomp(3' constant). Paired-end, both mates carry the ~86 nt insert (23+40+23).

Van Simaeys 2022 Nat Commun, human islet Cell-SELEX + toggle SELEX. Sullenger 2'F-RNA library (Supp Table 3; primary-source confirmed by Codex, orientation reconciled). Read-oriented (sense) flanks: 5'=AGGACGATGCGG (SUL5' core, preceded by a VARIABLE ILL-PF HT-seq tag that detect must skip), 3'=CAGACGACTCGCTGAGGATCCGAGA (= revcomp of the supp template-5'/SUL3' const; paper-grounded transform, like 9110/9111). TRONCONE 2. INDEPENDENTLY VALIDATED across ALL 12 runs (stream-sampled 200k reads/run = 2.4M; targeted non-circular check, not de-novo): 5' core 98.1-98.9% every run; 3' core CGCTGAGGATCCGAGA robust 89.8-96.8% every run; 3' EXACT 25-mer cycle-heterogeneous (3.2-94.4%). => 3' boundary HETEROGENEOUS: score allowing equivalent/partial (detect may return a shifted/core 3'). Cycles encoded in GEO sample titles (GSM->cycle); round_map auto may fall back to mono - curate a GSM->cycle map if multi-round inference is wanted.

Gao et al. 2026 Nat Commun "Aptamers with magnetically tunable affinity for divalent cobalt ions" (HM-SELEX/GO-SELEX, DNA aptamer vs Co2+ = small-ion target, NEW type for the benchmark). Library Supp Table 4 (primary-source via Codex): /FAM/-TACACTGCACTGCGTTAGAG-N40-ATGGACGTGTCACAGTACTG; RP-1=/biotin/-CAGTACTGTGACACGTCCAT=revcomp(3'). TRONCONE 2. INDEPENDENTLY VALIDATED (stream-sampled SRR36645706, 200k R1+R2, targeted non-circular check; paper confirmed real, Gao Nat Commun 2026): R1 carries 5' const 96.9% (within first 40bp, after a 1-nt variable library-prep base), R2 starts with revcomp(3')=RP-1 98.2%. Forward orientation, both flanks present + paper-grounded. Paired 150nt/mate, single run (mono_round).

Le Dortz et al. 2024 Sci Rep, DNA SELEX vs Anaplasma phagocytophilum (tick-borne intracellular bacterium, infected-cell extract). Paper library 5'-CTCCTCTGACTGTAACCACG-N40-GCATAGGTAGTCCAGAAGCC-3' (Methods; rev primer GGCTTCTGGACTACCTATGC). TRONCONE 2. Deposited reads are REVERSE-COMPLEMENT orientation (like 9110/9111), so primer_*_truth are the READ-orientation flanks: 5'=GGCTTCTGGACTACCTATGC (=revcomp paper 3' const = reverse primer), 3'=CGTGGTTACAGTCAGAGGAG (=revcomp paper 5' const) -- paper-grounded transforms. VALIDATED streaming (65k reads, targeted non-circular): revcomp(3')=95%, revcomp(5')=92% present, forward forms 0%. 85nt reads = raw full-length (20+40+20=80). 3' truth VERIFIED vs Le Dortz 2024 PMC10828505 M&M (forward primer CTCCTCTGACTGTAACCACG; revcomp = CGTGGTTACAGTCAGAGGAG = 3' truth, paper-grounded/unchanged). Deposited reads carry an extended/heterogeneous 3' boundary (read consensus ~CGTGGTTACAGTCAGAGGAC[T/A]GATT, 25nt; only ~half of reads share one 3' form), so the read-level 3' diverges from the clean paper primer -> expected 5'-EXACT / 3'-MEDIUM.
